<source id="FAQ-025" type="document">
How long do I have to return an item? (United Kingdom)

In the United Kingdom you can return unworn items within 28 days of delivery. See the returns policy for exceptions.
</source>
<source id="FAQ-028" type="document">
How long do I have to return an item? (European Union)

In the European Union you can return unworn items within 60 days of delivery. See the returns policy for exceptions.
</source>
<source id="FAQ-019" type="document">
How long do I have to return an item? (United States)

In the United States you can return unworn items within 30 days of delivery. See the returns policy for exceptions.
</source>
<source id="FAQ-022" type="document">
How long do I have to return an item? (Canada)

In Canada you can return unworn items within 45 days of delivery. See the returns policy for exceptions.
</source>
<source id="POL-RETURNS-UK" type="document">
Returns policy (United Kingdom) > Return window

You can return unworn, unwashed items within **28 days** of delivery
for a refund to the original payment method.
</source>
